migration_flags.detail: The procurement.group model is gone in v19. stock.move now uses reference_ids (Many2many to stock.reference) instead of group_id (Many2one to procurement.group). Any custom code using env['procurement.group'] or move.group_id will fail.

The packaging_ids Many2many field formerly on stock.route is absent from the v19 StockRoute model. Stale i18n translations (e.g. stock/i18n/es_CL.po:5167) confirm it existed before. The v19 equivalent is route_ids on stock.package.type (stock_package_type.py:39) plus package_type_selectable Boolean on stock.route.
No routing_id field exists anywhere in the stock addon Python files. The pattern matches the mrp.bom routing_id removal. Stock rules do not carry a routing_id reference in v19.
migration_flags.evidence: grep across stock/models/*.py returns zero results

migration_flags.detail: New field in v19. When True, the destination location on the created transfer is taken from the rule's location_dest_id rather than the picking type's default. Used by warehouse resupply rule creation.

migration_flags.summary: push_domain Char field added to stock.rule
migration_flags.detail: New field in v19. Allows conditional push rules via a domain expression evaluated against the incoming move. If the move does not match, that push rule is skipped and the next candidate is evaluated.

migration_flags.summary: procurement_values Json field added to stock.move
migration_flags.detail: New non-stored Json field on stock.move that carries serialized procurement context (BaseModel IDs, dates) through the move chain for downstream rule application.

migration_flags.summary: propagation_stock_picking_id does not exist in v19 stock community
migration_flags.detail: The field propagation_stock_picking_id referenced in research scope does not exist anywhere in the v19 stock community addon. It may be an Enterprise-only field or was removed in an earlier version.
migration_flags.evidence: grep across stock/models/*.py returns zero results

key_findings.push_chain: _push_apply() on stock.move calls _get_push_rule() then _run_push() per move after state='done'; push rules with auto='transparent' overwrite destination in place and recurse; auto='manual' creates a successor move via copy with procure_method='make_to_order'
key_findings.pull_chain: _run_pull() builds stock.move values via _get_stock_move_values() storing procurement location as location_final_id, then creates and confirms moves by company batch
key_findings.route_priority: Route lookup priority: explicit route_ids > package type routes > product+category routes > warehouse routes; within tier sorted by (route_sequence, sequence) ascending; location hierarchy walked upward on miss
key_findings.procurement_group_change: v19 replaces procurement.group with stock.reference; moves use reference_ids Many2many instead of group_id Many2one — BREAKING change for any integration
key_findings.packaging_ids_removed: stock.route.packaging_ids absent from v19 Python model; replaced by route_ids on stock.package.type
key_findings.mts_else_mto_handling: _run_pull() immediately downgrades mts_else_mto to make_to_stock; no base-stock forecast check at rule execution time
key_findings.cancel_propagation: propagate_cancel on rule defaults False; on move defaults True; cancellation only cascades forward if ALL sibling origin moves are also cancelled
